================================================================================
Rego explicit membership between two references is valid
================================================================================
{input.b in input.c}
---
(program (set (membership (ref (var) (var)) (ref (var) (var)))))

================================================================================
Rego set cannot invent an in operator from the following input reference
:error
================================================================================
{input.b
input.c}
---
(program (set (ERROR (ref (var) (var))) (ref (var) (var))))

================================================================================
Rego set cannot invent an in operator from an includes identifier
:error
================================================================================
{input.b
includes_value.c}
---
(program (set (ERROR (ref (var) (var))) (ref (var) (var))))

================================================================================
Rego includes function stays a new declaration after a call-valued assignment
================================================================================
combined_flags := sprintf(flags)
includes_no_install_recommends(command) if {input.value}
---
(program (assignment (var) (call (var) (var))) (definition (var) (var) (set (ref (var) (var)))))

================================================================================
Rego includes assume-yes function stays a new declaration
================================================================================
combined_flags := sprintf(flags)
includes_assume_yes(command) if {input.value}
---
(program (assignment (var) (call (var) (var))) (definition (var) (var) (set (ref (var) (var)))))

================================================================================
An actual in expression can belong to a conditional assignment
================================================================================
combined_flags := sprintf(flags) in includes_value(command) if {input.value}
---
(program (assignment (var) (membership (call (var) (var)) (call (var) (var))) (set (ref (var) (var)))))
